1→# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
     2→"""
     3→This file implements common components for MLA implementations.
     4→
     5→First we define:
     6→
     7→Sq      as Q sequence length
     8→Skv     as KV sequence length
     9→
    10→MLA has two possible ways of computing, a data-movement friendly approach and a
    11→compute friendly approach, we generally want to use the compute friendly
    12→approach for "prefill" (i.e. the ratio Sq / Skv is "small", is near 1)
    13→and the data-movement friendly approach for "decode" (i.e. the ratio
    14→Sq / Skv is "large").
    15→
    16→NOTE what we deem small and large is currently determined by if its labelled
    17→prefill or decode by the scheduler, but this is something we should probably
    18→tune.
    19→
    20→Main reference: DeepseekV2 paper, and FlashInfer Implementation
    21→(https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.04434 and https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/551).
    22→
    23→Deepseek's MLA attention works the following way:
    24→* Use a single latent vector to represent the per-token entry of the KV cache.
    25→* For decode (i.e. the memory friendly approach) the attention "simulates" a
    26→multi-head attention, while the compute is similar to multi-query attention.
    27→
    28→Below is example of both paths assuming batchsize = 1
    29→
    30→## More Extent Definitions:
    31→
    32→C           Context length, `Skv - Sq`
    33→H           hidden size
    34→N           number of attention heads
    35→Lq          latent dimension for Q              1536 in DSV3
    36→Lkv         latent dimension for K/V            512 in DSV3
    37→P           nope dimension, no rope.            128 in DSV3
    38→R           rope dimension, goes through rope.  64 in DSV3
    39→V           V head dim.                         128 in DSV3
    40→
    41→## Vector/Matrix Definitions
    42→
    43→h_t         hidden states (input to attention)  shape [Sq, H]
    44→q_c         latent/compressed Q                 shape [Sq, Lq]
    45→q_nope      uncompressed Q (no-rope)            shape [Sq, N, P]
    46→q_pe        uncompressed Q (rope)               shape [Sq, N, R]
    47→kv_c        latent/compressed KV                shape [Skv, Lkv]
    48→k_pe        decoupled k position embeddings     shape [Skv, R]
    49→new_kv_c    new kv_c from current iter          shape [Sq, Lkv]
    50→new_k_pe    new k_pe from current iter          shape [Sq, R]
    51→cache_kv_c  cached k_c from previous iters      shape [C, Lkv]
    52→cache_k_pe  cached k_pe from previous iters     shape [C, R]
    53→W_DQ        project h_t to q_c                  shape [H, Lq]
    54→W_UQ        project q_c to q_nope               shape [Lq, N * P]
    55→W_QR        project q_c to q_pe                 shape [Lq, N * R]
    56→W_DKV       project h_t to kv_c                 shape [H, Lkv]
    57→W_UK        project kv_c to k_nope              shape [Lkv, N * P]
    58→W_KR        project h_t to k_pe                 shape [H, N * R]
    59→W_UV        project kv_c to v                   shape [Lkv, N * V]
    60→W_O         project v to h_t                    shape [N * V, H]
    61→
    62→
    63→## Compute Friendly Approach (i.e. "_forward_prefill"):
    64→
    65→q_c      = h_t @ W_DQ
    66→q_nope   = (q_c @ W_UQ).view(Sq, N, P)
    67→q_pe     = RoPE(q_c @ W_QR).view(Sq, N, R)
    68→new_kv_c = h_t @ W_DKV
    69→new_k_pe = RoPE(h_t @ W_KR)
    70→kv_c     = torch.cat([new_kv_c, cache_kv_c], dim=0)
    71→k_pe     = torch.cat([new_k_pe, cache_k_pe], dim=0)
    72→k_nope   = (kv_c @ W_UK).view(Skv, N, P)
    73→v        = (kv_c @ W_UV).view(Skv, N, V)
    74→
    75→// MHA with QK headdim = P + R
    76→//           V headdim = V
    77→//      spda_o shape [Sq, N, V]
    78→spda_o = scaled_dot_product_attention(
    79→    torch.cat([q_nope, q_pe], dim=-1),
    80→    torch.cat([k_nope, k_pe.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, N, -1)], dim=-1),
    81→    v
    82→)
    83→return spda_o @ W_O
    84→
    85→NOTE: in the actual code,
    86→    `kv_b_proj` is [W_UK; W_UV] concatnated per head
    87→    `q_b_proj` is [W_UQ; W_QR] concatnated per head
    88→    `out_proj` is W_O
    89→
    90→
    91→## Data-Movement Friendly Approach (i.e. "_forward_decode"):
    92→
    93→Ahead of time, compute:
    94→
    95→% this projects from q_c to [Sq, N * Lkv]
    96→W_UQ_UK = einsum("qnp,knp -> qnk"
    97→                     W_UQ.view(Lq, N, P), W_UK.view(Lkv, N, P)
    98→                ).view(Lkv, N * Lkv)
    99→% this projects from attn output [Sq, N * Lkv] to [Sq, H]
   100→W_UV_O  = einsum("knv,nvh -> nkh"
   101→                     W_UV.view(Lkv, N, V), W_O.view(N, V, H)
   102→                ).view(N * Lkv, H)
   103→
   104→Runtime
   105→q_c      = h_t @ W_DQ
   106→q_latent = q_c @ W_UQ_UK.view(Sq, N, Lkv)
   107→q_pe     = RoPE(q_c @ W_QR).view(Sq, N, R)
   108→new_kv_c = h_t @ W_DKV
   109→new_k_pe = RoPE(h_t @ W_KR)
   110→kv_c     = torch.cat([new_kv_c, cache_kv_c], dim=0)
   111→k_pe     = torch.cat([new_k_pe, cache_k_pe], dim=0)
   112→
   113→// MQA with QK headdim = Lkv + R
   114→//           V headdim = Lkv
   115→//      spda_o shape [Sq, N, Lkv]
   116→// NOTE: this is less compute-friendly since Lkv > P
   117→//       but is more data-movement friendly since its MQA vs MHA
   118→spda_o = scaled_dot_product_attention(
   119→    torch.cat([q_latent, q_pe], dim=-1),
   120→    torch.cat([kv_c, k_pe], dim=-1),
   121→    kv_c
   122→)
   123→return spda_o.reshape(-1, N * Lkv) @ W_UV_O
   124→
   125→
   126→## Chunked Prefill
   127→
   128→For chunked prefill we want to use the compute friendly algorithm. We are
   129→assuming sufficiently large Sq / Skv ratio, in the future may want to switch to
   130→the data-movement friendly approach if the chunk (i.e. `Sq`) is small.
   131→
   132→However, the compute-friendly approach can potentially run out of memory if Skv
   133→is large due to: `k_nope = (kv_c @ W_UK).view(Skv, N, P)`
   134→
   135→To mitigate this, we chunk the computation of attention with respect to the
   136→current context (i.e. `cache_kv_c` and `cache_k_pe`) so that we can used a
   137→fixed workspace size.
   138→
   139→The chunked prefill approach is as follows:
   140→
   141→MCC        Max chunk of context to process per iter, computed dynamically,
   142→           used to bound the memory usage
   143→
   144→q_c        = h_t @ W_DQ
   145→q_nope     = (q_c @ W_UQ).view(Sq, N, P)
   146→q_pe       = RoPE(q_c @ W_QR).view(Sq, N, R)
   147→new_kv_c   = h_t @ W_DKV
   148→new_k_pe   = RoPE(h_t @ W_KR)
   149→new_k_nope = (new_kv_c @ W_UK).view(Sq, N, P)
   150→new_v      = (new_kv_c @ W_UV).view(Sq, N, V)
   151→
   152→// MHA between queries and new KV
   153→//     with QK headdim = P + R
   154→//           V headdim = V
   155→//    curr_o   shape [Sq, N, V]
   156→//    curr_lse shape [N, Sq], this is just order FA returns
   157→curr_o, curr_lse = scaled_dot_product_attention(
   158→    torch.cat([q_nope, q_pe], dim=-1),
   159→    torch.cat([new_k_nope, new_k_pe.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, N, -1)], dim=-1),
   160→    new_v,
   161→    casual=True,
   162→    return_softmax_lse=True
   163→)
   164→
   165→// Compute attention with the already existing context
   166→for chunk_idx in range(cdiv(C, MCC)):
   167→    chunk_start  = chunk_idx * MCC
   168→    chunk_end    = min(chunk_start + MCC, C)
   169→    Sc           = chunk_end - chunk_start
   170→    cache_kv_c_chunk   = cache_kv_c[chunk_start:chunk_end]
   171→    cache_k_pe_chunk   = cache_k_pe[chunk_start:chunk_end]
   172→    cache_k_nope_chunk = (cache_kv_c_chunk @ W_UK).view(-1, N, P)
   173→    cache_v_chunk      = (cache_kv_c_chunk @ W_UV).view(-1, N, V)
   174→
   175→    chunk_o, chunk_lse = scaled_dot_product_attention(
   176→        torch.cat([q_nope, q_pe], dim=-1),
   177→        torch.cat([cache_k_nope_chunk,
   178→                   cache_k_pe_chunk.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, N, -1)],
   179→                   dim=-1),
   180→        cache_v_chunk,
   181→        casual=False,
   182→        return_softmax_lse=True
   183→    )
   184→
   185→    curr_o, curr_lse = merge_attn_states(
   186→        suffix_output=curr_o,
   187→        suffix_lse=curr_lse,
   188→        prefix_output=chunk_o,
   189→        prefix_lse=chunk_lse,
   190→    )
   191→
   192→return curr_o @ W_O
   193→"""

   311→@dataclass
   312→class MLACommonMetadata(Generic[D]):
   313→    """Metadata for MLACommon.
   314→
   315→    NOTE: Please read the comment at the top of the file before trying to
   316→    understand this class
   317→    """
   318→    # NOTE(sang): Definition of context_len, query_len, and seq_len.
   319→    # |---------- N-1 iteration --------|
   320→    # |---------------- N iteration ---------------------|
   321→    # |- tokenA -|......................|-- newTokens ---|
   322→    # |---------- context_len ----------|
   323→    # |-------------------- seq_len ---------------------|
   324→    #                                   |-- query_len ---|

   326→    num_actual_tokens: int  # Number of tokens excluding padding.
   327→    query_start_loc: torch.Tensor
   328→    slot_mapping: torch.Tensor

   348→                not in supported_head_sizes:

   357→class MLACommonMetadataBuilder(Generic[M]):
   358→    """
   359→    NOTE: Please read the comment at the top of the file before trying to
   360→    understand this class
   361→    """
   362→
   363→    def __init__(self,
   364→                 runner: "GPUModelRunner",
   365→                 metadata_cls: Optional[type[M]] = None):
   366→        self.metadata_cls = metadata_cls \
   367→            if metadata_cls is not None else MLACommonMetadata
   368→        self.runner = runner
   369→        scheduler_config = runner.scheduler_config
   370→        model_config = runner.model_config
   371→        cache_config = runner.cache_config
   372→        self.chunked_prefill_enabled = scheduler_config.chunked_prefill_enabled
   373→
   374→        if self.chunked_prefill_enabled:
   375→            self.chunked_prefill_workspace_size = min(
   376→                # Max sure there is enough for 8 full length request or at least
   377→                # 4 pages of cache per request
   378→                max(
   379→                    8 * model_config.max_model_len, 4 *
   380→                    scheduler_config.max_num_seqs * cache_config.block_size),
   381→                # For long-context models try not to over-allocate limiting
   382→                # kv-cache space, limiting it to 64k tokens,
   383→                # which would result in the workspace being:
   384→                #   2*(576)*(64*1024) = 144mb
   385→                # (assuming 576 MLA head dim, and fp16)
   386→                # which would result in up-projected context being
   387→                #   2*(192*128)*(64*1024) = 3gb
   388→                # (assuming 192 QK head dim, 128 heads, and fp16)
   389→                128 * 1024)
   390→            assert self.chunked_prefill_workspace_size >= \
   391→                scheduler_config.max_num_seqs * cache_config.block_size
   392→            self.chunked_prefill_workspace = torch.empty(
   393→                (self.chunked_prefill_workspace_size,
   394→                 model_config.get_head_size()),
   395→                dtype=model_config.dtype,
   396→                device=runner.device,
   397→            )
   398→            self.page_size = self.runner.block_size
   399→
   400→    def reorder_batch(self, input_batch: "InputBatch",
   401→                      scheduler_output: "SchedulerOutput") -> bool:
   402→        # We now want to reorder the batch so that the "decode" requests are and
   403→        # the front and the "prefill" requests are at the using the least amount
   404→        # swaps possible. (NOTE for now we loosely use "decode" to mean requests
   405→        # where attention is likely memory-bound and "prefill" to mean requests
   406→        # where attention is likely compute-bound, TODO(lucas): figure out a
   407→        # better naming here)
   408→        decodes = []
   409→        prefills = []
   410→        num_decode_tokens = 0
   411→        num_prefill_tokens = 0
   412→
   413→        for i, req_id in enumerate(input_batch.req_ids):
   414→            num_tokens = scheduler_output.num_scheduled_tokens[req_id]
   415→            # for now treat 1 scheduled token as "decode" even if its not,
   416→            # we should update this to something like < 8 in the future but
   417→            # currently the TritonMLA._forward_decode only supports
   418→            # num_tokens = 1
   419→            if num_tokens == 1:
   420→                decodes.append(i)
   421→                num_decode_tokens += num_tokens
   422→            else:
   423→                prefills.append(i)
   424→                num_prefill_tokens += num_tokens
   425→
   426→        # We hope that this is fairly minimal since decodes
   427→        # should be around for a number of iterations so hopefully they are
   428→        # relatively stationary (and new request are generally appended to the
   429→        # persistent batch so already should be at the back)
   430→        # To achieve this we loop over the decodes in descending order and
   431→        # the prefills in ascending order. We swap decodes from the  "back"
   432→        # i.e. past where the last decode should be in the reodorered with
   433→        # prefills from the front of the batch.
   434→        # `decodes` and `prefills` are already in ascending order just based on
   435→        # the above loop
   436→        num_decodes = len(decodes)
   437→        num_prefills = len(prefills)
   438→        first_prefill = 0
   439→        modified_batch = False
   440→
   441→        for i in range(1, min(num_decodes, num_prefills) + 1):
   442→            # If the decode is at the "back" of the batch, i, we can swap it
   443→            # with the prefill closest to the front of the batch
   444→            if decodes[num_decodes - i] >= num_decodes:
   445→                input_batch.swap_states(prefills[first_prefill],
   446→                                        decodes[num_decodes - i])
   447→                first_prefill += 1
   448→                modified_batch = True
   449→            else:
   450→                break
   451→
   452→        # Save for next `build` call
   453→        # TODO(lucas): this is a bit of a hack, we should probably have a
   454→        # better way of doing this
   455→        self._num_decodes = num_decodes
   456→        self._num_prefills = num_prefills
   457→        self._num_decode_tokens = num_decode_tokens
   458→        self._num_prefill_tokens = num_prefill_tokens
   459→
   460→        return modified_batch
   461→
   462→    def _build_decode(self, input_positions: torch.Tensor,
   463→                      block_table: torch.Tensor, seq_lens: torch.Tensor):
   464→        return MLACommonDecodeMetadata(
   465→            input_positions=input_positions,
   466→            block_table=block_table,
   467→            seq_lens=seq_lens,
   468→        )
   469→
   470→    def build(self, num_reqs: int, num_actual_tokens: int, max_query_len: int,
   471→              common_prefix_len: int) -> M:
   472→        assert self._num_decodes + self._num_prefills == num_reqs
   473→
   474→        device = self.runner.device
   475→        query_start_loc = self.runner.query_start_loc_cpu[:num_reqs + 1].to(
   476→            device, non_blocking=True)
   477→        seq_lens = self.runner.seq_lens_cpu[:num_reqs].to(device,
   478→                                                          non_blocking=True)
   479→        block_table = (
   480→            self.runner.input_batch.block_table.get_device_tensor()[:num_reqs])
   481→        slot_mapping = self.runner.slot_mapping_cpu[:num_actual_tokens].to(
   482→            device, non_blocking=True).long()
   483→        input_positions = self.runner.positions_cpu[:num_actual_tokens].to(
   484→            device, non_blocking=True).long()
   485→
   486→        prefill_metadata = None
   487→        if self._num_prefills > 0:
   488→            reqs_start = self._num_decodes  # prefill_start
   489→            tokens_start = self._num_decode_tokens
   490→
   491→            context_lens_cpu = self.runner.input_batch.\
   492→                num_computed_tokens_cpu_tensor[reqs_start:num_reqs]
   493→            context_lens = context_lens_cpu.to(device, non_blocking=True)
   494→
   495→            chunked_context_metadata = None
   496→            if self.chunked_prefill_enabled and self._num_prefills > 0 \
   497→                and context_lens.max() > 0:
   498→                # NOTE: it is recommend you read the `Chunked Prefill` section
   499→                # in the comment at the top of the file before trying to
   500→                # understand the following code
   501→
   502→                num_prefills_with_context = (context_lens > 0).sum().item()
   503→
   504→                # currently we allocate an equal amount of workspace for each
   505→                # prefill in the batch, we could probably use a more advanced
   506→                # algorithm here and allocate more workspace to prefills with
   507→                # longer context lengths
   508→                max_context_chunk = \
   509→                    self.chunked_prefill_workspace_size \
   510→                        // num_prefills_with_context
   511→
   512→                # align max_context_chunk to page_size by rounding down,
   513→                # currently the `gather_cache` kernel cannot handle
   514→                # `context_chunk_starts` that are not aligned to page_size
   515→                max_context_chunk = round_down(max_context_chunk,
   516→                                               self.page_size)
   517→
   518→                assert max_context_chunk > 0
   519→                num_chunks = cdiv(context_lens.max(), max_context_chunk)
   520→
   521→                # if `max_context_chunk = 256`, `num_chunks = 3`, and
   522→                #   `num_prefills_with_context = 4`, create a tensor that looks
   523→                # like
   524→                #  [[0, 0, 0, 0], [256, 256, 256, 256], [512, 512, 512, 512]]
   525→                chunk_starts = \
   526→                    torch.arange(num_chunks, device=device, dtype=torch.int32) \
   527→                    .unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, self._num_prefills) \
   528→                    * max_context_chunk
   529→                chunk_ends = torch.min(context_lens.unsqueeze(0),
   530→                                       chunk_starts + max_context_chunk)
   531→                chunk_seq_lens = (chunk_ends - chunk_starts).clamp(min=0)
   532→                _chunk_cu_seq_lens = chunk_seq_lens.cumsum(dim=1).to(
   533→                    torch.int32)
   534→                zero = torch.zeros(num_chunks,
   535→                                   dtype=torch.int32,
   536→                                   device=device).unsqueeze(-1)
   537→
   538→                chunked_context_metadata = \
   539→                    MLACommonPrefillMetadata.ChunkedContextMetadata(
   540→                    cu_seq_lens=torch.cat(
   541→                        [zero, _chunk_cu_seq_lens], dim=1),
   542→                    starts=chunk_starts,
   543→                    seq_tot=chunk_seq_lens.sum(dim=1).tolist(),
   544→                    max_seq_lens=chunk_seq_lens.max(dim=1).values.tolist(),
   545→                    workspace=self.chunked_prefill_workspace,
   546→                )
   547→
   548→                assert max(chunked_context_metadata.max_seq_lens) <= \
   549→                    self.chunked_prefill_workspace_size
   550→
   551→            prefill_metadata = MLACommonPrefillMetadata(
   552→                input_positions=input_positions[tokens_start:],
   553→                block_table=block_table[reqs_start:, ...],
   554→                query_start_loc=query_start_loc[reqs_start:] -
   555→                query_start_loc[reqs_start],
   556→                max_query_len=seq_lens[reqs_start:].max().item(),
   557→                chunked_context=chunked_context_metadata,
   558→            )
   559→
   560→        decode_metadata = None
   561→        if self._num_decodes > 0:
   562→            decode_metadata = self._build_decode(
   563→                input_positions=input_positions[:self._num_decode_tokens],
   564→                block_table=block_table[:self._num_decodes, ...],
   565→                seq_lens=seq_lens[:self._num_decodes],
   566→            )
   567→
   568→        return self.metadata_cls(
   569→            num_actual_tokens=num_actual_tokens,
   570→            query_start_loc=query_start_loc,
   571→            slot_mapping=slot_mapping,
   572→            head_dim=self.runner.model_config.get_head_size(),
   573→            # MLACommonMetadata Chunk prefill specific
   574→            num_decodes=self._num_decodes,
   575→            num_decode_tokens=self._num_decode_tokens,
   576→            num_prefills=self._num_prefills,
   577→            prefill=prefill_metadata,
   578→            decode=decode_metadata,
   579→        )

   649→    def _v_up_proj_and_o_proj(self, x):
   650→        if envs.VLLM_MLA_PERFORM_MATRIX_ABSORPTION:
   651→            if is_fp8(self.W_UV_O):
   652→                output_parallel = self.fp8_linear_generic.apply(
   653→                    x.flatten(start_dim=1), self.W_UV_O, self.W_UV_O_scales,
   654→                    self.reqaunt_input_group_shape,
   655→                    self.reqaunt_weight_group_shape)
   656→            else:
   657→                output_parallel = torch.matmul(x.flatten(start_dim=1),
   658→                                               self.W_UV_O)
   659→            if self.tp_size > 1:
   660→                output = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(output_parallel)
   661→            else:
   662→                output = output_parallel
   663→            return output
   664→        else:
   665→            x = torch.einsum("bnl,lnv->bnv", x, self.W_UV)
   666→            return self.o_proj(x.reshape(-1,
   667→                                         self.num_heads * self.v_head_dim))[0]
   668→
   669→    def _q_proj_and_k_up_proj(self, x):
   670→        if envs.VLLM_MLA_PERFORM_MATRIX_ABSORPTION:
   671→            if is_fp8(self.W_Q_UK):
   672→                return self.fp8_linear_generic.apply(
   673→                    x, self.W_Q_UK, self.W_Q_UK_scales,
   674→                    self.reqaunt_input_group_shape,
   675→                    self.reqaunt_weight_group_shape).view(
   676→                        -1, self.num_heads, self.kv_lora_rank)
   677→            return torch.matmul(x, self.W_Q_UK)\
   678→                .view(-1, self.num_heads, self.kv_lora_rank)
   679→        else:
   680→            x = torch.matmul(x, self.W_Q)\
   681→                .view(-1, self.num_heads, self.qk_nope_head_dim)
   682→            return torch.einsum("bnp,lnp->bnl", x, self.W_UK)\
   683→                .view(-1, self.num_heads, self.kv_lora_rank)

   685→    def process_weights_after_loading(self, act_dtype: torch.dtype):
   686→
   687→        # TODO(lucas) This is very gross, we need a more wide scale refactor of
   688→        # all the FP8 code with a more standard way of
   689→        # defining schemes/group-shapes, we should also potentially force
   690→        # quant_methods to support a decompress function
   691→        #
   692→        # returns input_group_shape, weight_group_shape
   693→        def get_scale_group_shapes_for_fp8(layer: LinearBase) -> \
   694→            tuple[tuple[int, int], tuple[int, int]]:
   695→            if isinstance(layer.quant_method, Fp8LinearMethod):
   696→                if layer.quant_method.block_quant:
   697→                    weight_block_size = \
   698→                        layer.quant_method.quant_config.weight_block_size
   699→                    # per-token-group (1, X), block-quantized (X, Y)
   700→                    return (1, weight_block_size[-1]), weight_block_size
   701→                else:
   702→                    return (-1, -1), (-1, -1)  # per-tensor, per-tensor
   703→            elif isinstance(layer.quant_method, CompressedTensorsLinearMethod)\
   704→                and isinstance(layer.scheme, CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8):
   705→                # this is hacky but we always assume the for
   706→                # CompressedTensorsW8A8Fp8 the input is dynamic per-token
   707→                # we ignore if it is static-per-tensor since we are going to
   708→                # requantize after later anyways
   709→                strategy = layer.scheme.strategy
   710→                if strategy == QuantizationStrategy.TENSOR:
   711→                    return (1, -1), (-1, -1)  # per-token, per-tensor
   712→                elif strategy == QuantizationStrategy.CHANNEL:
   713→                    return (1, -1), (-1, 1)  # per-token, per-channel
   714→                else:
   715→                    raise NotImplementedError(
   716→                        f"QuantizationStrategy.{strategy} is not supported for "
   717→                        "fp8 MLA, please run with VLLM_MLA_DISABLE=1")
   718→            else:
   719→                raise NotImplementedError(
   720→                    "Can't determine scale group shapes for "
   721→                    f"{layer.quant_method}, please run with VLLM_MLA_DISABLE=1"
   722→                )
   723→
   724→        def get_layer_weight(layer):
   725→            if hasattr(layer, "weight"):
   726→                return layer.weight
   727→            elif hasattr(layer, "qweight"):
   728→                return layer.qweight
   729→            else:
   730→                raise AttributeError(
   731→                    f"Layer '{layer}' has neither weight nor qweight")
   732→
   733→        def get_and_maybe_dequant_weights(layer: LinearBase):
   734→            if not isinstance(layer.quant_method, UnquantizedLinearMethod):
   735→                # NOTE: This should only be used offline, since it's O(N^3)
   736→                eye = torch.eye(layer.input_size_per_partition,
   737→                                dtype=act_dtype,
   738→                                device=get_layer_weight(layer).device)
   739→                dequant_weights = layer.quant_method.apply(layer,
   740→                                                           eye,
   741→                                                           bias=None)
   742→                del eye
   743→                # standardize to (output, input)
   744→                return dequant_weights.T
   745→            return layer.weight
   746→
   747→        weight_dtype = get_layer_weight(self.kv_b_proj).dtype
   748→        assert get_layer_weight(self.o_proj).dtype == weight_dtype
   749→        assert get_layer_weight(self.q_proj).dtype == weight_dtype
   750→
   751→        kv_b_proj_weight = get_and_maybe_dequant_weights(self.kv_b_proj).T
   752→        assert kv_b_proj_weight.shape == (
   753→            self.kv_lora_rank,
   754→            self.num_heads * (self.qk_nope_head_dim + self.v_head_dim)), (
   755→                f"{kv_b_proj_weight.shape=}, "
   756→                f"{self.kv_lora_rank=}, "
   757→                f"{self.num_heads=}, "
   758→                f"{self.qk_nope_head_dim=}, "
   759→                f"{self.v_head_dim=}")
   760→        kv_b_proj_weight = kv_b_proj_weight.view(
   761→            self.kv_lora_rank,
   762→            self.num_heads,
   763→            self.qk_nope_head_dim + self.v_head_dim,
   764→        )
   765→
   766→        W_UK, W_UV = kv_b_proj_weight.split(
   767→            [self.qk_nope_head_dim, self.v_head_dim], dim=-1)
   768→
   769→        q_proj_weight = get_and_maybe_dequant_weights(self.q_proj).T\
   770→                .view(-1, self.num_heads, self.qk_head_dim)
   771→
   772→        # can be W_Q or W_UQ depending q_lora_rank, the former if
   773→        # q_lora_rank is None, the latter otherwise. From the Attention backend
   774→        # perspective though we call these both W_Q and rely on the layer
   775→        # to pass in the correct matrix
   776→        W_Q = q_proj_weight[..., :self.qk_nope_head_dim]
   777→        self.W_QR = q_proj_weight[..., self.qk_nope_head_dim:]\
   778→            .flatten(start_dim=1).contiguous()
   779→
   780→        # W_QR is small so for simplicity we dont bother requantizing it
   781→        self.W_QR = self.W_QR.to(act_dtype)
   782→
   783→        if envs.VLLM_MLA_PERFORM_MATRIX_ABSORPTION:
   784→            requantization_enabled = not envs.VLLM_MLA_DISABLE_REQUANTIZATION
   785→            if is_fp8(weight_dtype) and requantization_enabled:
   786→                # This assumes it wise to requantize using the same group shapes
   787→                # (i.e. strategy, per-tensor, per-channel, block etc.) that the
   788→                # weights were originally quantized
   789→                requant_input_group_shape, requant_weight_group_shape = \
   790→                    get_scale_group_shapes_for_fp8(self.q_proj)
   791→                assert (requant_input_group_shape, requant_weight_group_shape)\
   792→                    == get_scale_group_shapes_for_fp8(self.kv_b_proj)
   793→                assert (requant_input_group_shape, requant_weight_group_shape)\
   794→                    == get_scale_group_shapes_for_fp8(self.o_proj)
   795→                self.reqaunt_input_group_shape = requant_input_group_shape
   796→                self.reqaunt_weight_group_shape = requant_weight_group_shape
   797→
   798→            #
   799→            # Perform matrix-absorption following
   800→            #     https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/pull/551
   801→            # for decode, as a result we end up with absorbed weights for decode
   802→            # and another copy of raw weights for prefill.
   803→            #
   804→            self.W_UK, self.W_UV = kv_b_proj_weight.split(
   805→                [self.qk_nope_head_dim, self.v_head_dim], dim=-1)
   806→            # We absorb `W_UK` into `W_Q` resulting in either W_Q_UK or W_UQ_UK
   807→            # depending q_lora_rank, the former if q_lora_rank is None, the
   808→            # latter otherwise
   809→            # basically if q_lora_rank is none we are absorbing into q_proj
   810→            # instead of UQ
   811→            W_Q_UK = torch.einsum("qnd,lnd -> qnl", W_Q, W_UK)\
   812→                .flatten(start_dim=1).contiguous()
   813→
   814→            if is_fp8(weight_dtype) and requantization_enabled:
   815→                W_Q_UK, W_Q_UK_scales = scaled_quantize(
   816→                    W_Q_UK,
   817→                    self.reqaunt_weight_group_shape,
   818→                    quant_dtype=current_platform_fp8_dtype)
   819→                # For FP8 save the transpose so we can use
   820→                # `apply_w8a8_block_fp8_linear` directly
   821→                self.W_Q_UK = W_Q_UK.T.contiguous()
   822→                self.W_Q_UK_scales = W_Q_UK_scales.T.contiguous()
   823→            else:
   824→                self.W_Q_UK = W_Q_UK.to(act_dtype)
   825→
   826→            W_O = get_and_maybe_dequant_weights(self.o_proj)\
   827→                .view(-1, self.num_heads, self.v_head_dim)
   828→            W_UV_O = torch.einsum("lnd,hnd -> nlh", W_UV, W_O)\
   829→                .flatten(start_dim=0, end_dim=1).contiguous()
   830→
   831→            if is_fp8(weight_dtype) and requantization_enabled:
   832→                W_UV_O, W_UV_O_scales = scaled_quantize(
   833→                    W_UV_O,
   834→                    self.reqaunt_weight_group_shape,
   835→                    quant_dtype=current_platform_fp8_dtype)
   836→                # For FP8 save the transpose so we can use
   837→                # `apply_w8a8_block_fp8_linear` directly
   838→                self.W_UV_O = W_UV_O.T.contiguous()
   839→                self.W_UV_O_scales = W_UV_O_scales.T.contiguous()
   840→            else:
   841→                self.W_UV_O = W_UV_O.to(act_dtype)
   842→
   843→            self.tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
   844→        else:
   845→            if is_fp8(weight_dtype):
   846→                raise NotImplementedError(
   847→                    "Currently fp8 requires matrix absorption")
   848→
   849→            self.W_UV = W_UV
   850→            self.W_UK = W_UK
   851→            self.W_Q = W_Q.flatten(start_dim=1)
   852→
   853→    def _compute_prefill_context(
   854→        self,
   855→        q: torch.Tensor,
   856→        kv_c_and_k_pe_cache: torch.Tensor,
   857→        attn_metadata: MLACommonMetadata,
   858→    ):
   859→        assert attn_metadata.prefill is not None
   860→        prefill_metadata = attn_metadata.prefill
   861→        assert prefill_metadata.chunked_context is not None
   862→
   863→        output = None
   864→        iters = len(prefill_metadata.chunked_context.seq_tot)
   865→        workspace = prefill_metadata.chunked_context.workspace
   866→
   867→        for i in range(iters):
   868→            toks = prefill_metadata.chunked_context.seq_tot[i]
   869→
   870→            ops.gather_cache(
   871→                src_cache=kv_c_and_k_pe_cache,
   872→                dst=workspace,
   873→                block_table=prefill_metadata.block_table,
   874→                cu_seq_lens=prefill_metadata.chunked_context.cu_seq_lens[i],
   875→                batch_size=attn_metadata.num_prefills,
   876→                seq_starts=prefill_metadata.chunked_context.starts[i],
   877→            )
   878→
   879→            kv_c_normed = workspace[:toks]\
   880→                [..., :self.kv_lora_rank]
   881→            k_pe = workspace[:toks]\
   882→                [..., self.kv_lora_rank:].unsqueeze(1)
   883→
   884→            kv_nope = self.kv_b_proj(kv_c_normed)[0].view( \
   885→                -1, self.num_heads, self.qk_nope_head_dim + self.v_head_dim)
   886→            k_nope, v = kv_nope\
   887→                .split([self.qk_nope_head_dim, self.v_head_dim], dim=-1)
   888→
   889→            k = torch.cat((k_nope, k_pe.expand((*k_nope.shape[:-1], -1))),
   890→                          dim=-1)
   891→
   892→            # For MLA the v head dim is smaller than qk head dim so we pad
   893→            # out v with 0s to match the qk head dim
   894→            v_padded = torch.nn.functional.pad(v,
   895→                                               [0, q.shape[-1] - v.shape[-1]],
   896→                                               value=0)
   897→
   898→            attn_output, attn_softmax_lse = self.flash_attn_varlen_func(
   899→                q=q,
   900→                k=k,
   901→                v=v_padded,
   902→                cu_seqlens_q=prefill_metadata.query_start_loc,
   903→                cu_seqlens_k=prefill_metadata.chunked_context.cu_seq_lens[i],
   904→                max_seqlen_q=prefill_metadata.max_query_len,
   905→                max_seqlen_k=prefill_metadata.chunked_context.max_seq_lens[i],
   906→                softmax_scale=self.scale,
   907→                causal=False,  # Context is unmasked
   908→                return_softmax_lse=True,
   909→            )
   910→
   911→            if output is None:
   912→                output = attn_output
   913→                output_lse = attn_softmax_lse
   914→            else:
   915→                output_tmp = torch.empty_like(output)
   916→                output_lse_tmp = torch.empty_like(output_lse)
   917→                merge_attn_states(
   918→                    output=output_tmp,
   919→                    output_lse=output_lse_tmp,
   920→                    prefix_output=output,
   921→                    prefix_lse=output_lse,
   922→                    suffix_output=attn_output,
   923→                    suffix_lse=attn_softmax_lse,
   924→                )
   925→                output = output_tmp
   926→                output_lse = output_lse_tmp
   927→
   928→        return output, output_lse
   929→
   930→    def _forward_prefill(
   931→        self,
   932→        q: torch.Tensor,
   933→        kv_c_normed: torch.Tensor,
   934→        k_pe: torch.Tensor,
   935→        kv_c_and_k_pe_cache: torch.Tensor,
   936→        attn_metadata: MLACommonMetadata,
   937→    ) -> torch.Tensor:
   938→        assert attn_metadata.prefill is not None
   939→
   940→        has_context = attn_metadata.prefill.chunked_context is not None
   941→        kv_nope = self.kv_b_proj(kv_c_normed)[0].view(\
   942→            -1, self.num_heads, self.qk_nope_head_dim + self.v_head_dim)
   943→        k_nope, v = kv_nope\
   944→            .split([self.qk_nope_head_dim, self.v_head_dim], dim=-1)
   945→
   946→        k = torch.cat((k_nope, k_pe.expand((*k_nope.shape[:-1], -1))), dim=-1)
   947→
   948→        # For MLA the v head dim is smaller than qk head dim so we pad out
   949→        # v with 0s to match the qk head dim
   950→        v_padded = torch.nn.functional.pad(v, [0, q.shape[-1] - v.shape[-1]],
   951→                                           value=0)
   952→
   953→        output = self.flash_attn_varlen_func(
   954→            q=q,
   955→            k=k,
   956→            v=v_padded,
   957→            cu_seqlens_q=attn_metadata.prefill.query_start_loc,
   958→            cu_seqlens_k=attn_metadata.prefill.query_start_loc,
   959→            max_seqlen_q=attn_metadata.prefill.max_query_len,
   960→            max_seqlen_k=attn_metadata.prefill.max_query_len,
   961→            softmax_scale=self.scale,
   962→            causal=True,
   963→            return_softmax_lse=has_context,
   964→        )
   965→
   966→        if has_context:
   967→            suffix_output, suffix_lse = output
   968→            context_output, context_lse = self._compute_prefill_context( \
   969→                q, kv_c_and_k_pe_cache, attn_metadata)
   970→
   971→            output = torch.empty_like(suffix_output)
   972→            merge_attn_states(
   973→                output=output,
   974→                prefix_output=context_output,
   975→                prefix_lse=context_lse,
   976→                suffix_output=suffix_output,
   977→                suffix_lse=suffix_lse,
   978→            )
   979→
   980→        # slice by `:v.shape[-1]` in order to remove v headdim padding
   981→        output = output\
   982→            .view(-1, self.num_heads, q.shape[-1])[..., :v.shape[-1]]\
   983→                .reshape(-1, self.num_heads * v.shape[-1])
   984→
   985→        return self.o_proj(output)[0]
   986→
   987→    @abstractmethod
   988→    def _forward_decode(
   989→        self,
   990→        q_nope: torch.Tensor,
   991→        q_pe: torch.Tensor,
   992→        kv_c_and_k_pe_cache: torch.Tensor,
   993→        attn_metadata: M,
   994→    ) -> torch.Tensor:
   995→        raise NotImplementedError
   996→
   997→    def forward(
   998→        self,
   999→        layer: AttentionLayer,
  1000→        hidden_states_or_q_c: torch.Tensor,  # query in unified attn
  1001→        k_c_normed: torch.Tensor,  # key in unified attn
  1002→        k_pe: torch.Tensor,  # value in unified attn
  1003→        kv_cache: torch.Tensor,
  1004→        attn_metadata: M,
  1005→        output: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
  1006→    ) -> torch.Tensor:
  1007→
  1008→        assert output is not None, "Output tensor must be provided."
  1009→
  1010→        if attn_metadata is None:
  1011→            # Profiling run.
  1012→            return output
  1013→
  1014→        num_actual_toks = attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens
  1015→
  1016→        # Inputs and outputs may be padded for CUDA graphs
  1017→        output_padded = output
  1018→        output = output[:num_actual_toks, ...]
  1019→        hidden_states_or_q_c = hidden_states_or_q_c[:num_actual_toks, ...]
  1020→        k_c_normed = k_c_normed[:num_actual_toks, ...]
  1021→        k_pe = k_pe[:num_actual_toks, ...]
  1022→
  1023→        # Restore head dim (for rotary embedding)
  1024→        k_pe = k_pe.unsqueeze(1)
  1025→
  1026→        assert attn_metadata.num_decodes is not None and \
  1027→            attn_metadata.num_prefills is not None and \
  1028→            attn_metadata.num_decode_tokens is not None
  1029→
  1030→        has_decode = attn_metadata.num_decodes > 0
  1031→        has_prefill = attn_metadata.num_prefills > 0
  1032→        num_decode_tokens = attn_metadata.num_decode_tokens
  1033→
  1034→        decode_hs_or_q_c = hidden_states_or_q_c[:num_decode_tokens]
  1035→        decode_k_pe = k_pe[:num_decode_tokens]
  1036→
  1037→        prefill_hs_or_q_c = hidden_states_or_q_c[num_decode_tokens:]
  1038→        prefill_k_pe = k_pe[num_decode_tokens:]
  1039→        prefill_k_c_normed = k_c_normed[num_decode_tokens:]
  1040→
  1041→        if has_decode:
  1042→            assert attn_metadata.decode is not None
  1043→            decode_q_nope = self._q_proj_and_k_up_proj(decode_hs_or_q_c)
  1044→            decode_q_pe = torch.matmul(decode_hs_or_q_c, self.W_QR)\
  1045→                .view(-1, self.num_heads, self.qk_rope_head_dim)
  1046→            decode_q_pe[...], decode_k_pe[...] = self.rotary_emb(
  1047→                attn_metadata.decode.input_positions, decode_q_pe, decode_k_pe)
  1048→
  1049→        if has_prefill:
  1050→            assert attn_metadata.prefill is not None
  1051→            prefill_q = self.q_proj(prefill_hs_or_q_c)[0]\
  1052→                .view(-1, self.num_heads, self.qk_head_dim)
  1053→            prefill_q_pe = prefill_q[..., self.qk_nope_head_dim:]
  1054→            prefill_q_pe[...], prefill_k_pe[...] = self.rotary_emb(
  1055→                attn_metadata.prefill.input_positions, prefill_q_pe,
  1056→                prefill_k_pe)
  1057→
  1058→        # write the latent and rope to kv cache
  1059→        if kv_cache.numel() > 0:
  1060→            ops.concat_and_cache_mla(
  1061→                k_c_normed,
  1062→                k_pe.squeeze(1),
  1063→                kv_cache,
  1064→                attn_metadata.slot_mapping.flatten(),
  1065→                kv_cache_dtype=self.kv_cache_dtype,
  1066→                scale=layer._k_scale,
  1067→            )
  1068→
  1069→        if has_prefill:
  1070→            output[num_decode_tokens:] = self._forward_prefill(
  1071→                prefill_q, prefill_k_c_normed, prefill_k_pe, kv_cache,
  1072→                attn_metadata)
  1073→
  1074→        if has_decode:
  1075→            output[:num_decode_tokens] = self._forward_decode(
  1076→                decode_q_nope, decode_q_pe, kv_cache, attn_metadata)
  1077→
  1078→        return output_padded
  1079→
